Bug_Title: SA: Self assignment of local rather than assignment to field (SA_LOCAL_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_INSTEAD_OF_FIELD)
Bug_Explanation: In the setFoo method, the local variable foo is assigned to itself instead of being assigned to the instance variable foo.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the showBug method. The bug itself is that in the setFoo method, the local variable foo is assigned to itself instead of being assigned to the instance variable foo. This leads to the instance variable foo being assigned the default value (0) instead of the passed value (10). The test case checks if foo is equal to 10, which will fail as foo is 0 after calling showBug.
